reviewer_role: Independent statistical-data reviewer; no production edits
purpose: Check the development-only binary population-world prerequisite against the retained information assessment and research contract sections 5.3, 5.4 and 11. This review is not a whole-framework assessment.
conclusion: No remaining substantiated implementation defect found in the bounded review after the recorded fixes. Fixed mathematical identities and adversarial software checks support the declared estimator-response stress model only; they do not establish market adequacy, calibration, power or N_min.
source_context: Existing owned evaluation plans, development execution bindings, retained diagnostics and source-byte replay

mathematical_assessment.population: With development eligible q and w=P(C=true | eligible), including unknown C in the denominator, p_true=q+e and p_other=q-w*e/(1-w) imply w*p_true+(1-w)*p_other=q and p_true-q=e. Feasibility and 0<w<1, 0<q<1 are checked without clipping.
mathematical_assessment.mask_and_latent_stationarity: Uniform initialization and exact rational restart probability 1/L preserve the full joint time-mask marginal. Independent uniform integer common/private states, refreshed with probability 1-rho, preserve threshold marginals. Independent per-instrument common-share choices preserve these marginals. This is an ideal probability-law argument, not a finite PRNG certification.
mathematical_assessment.population_not_realized_ratio: The identities describe eligible nonterminal row-population conditioning. They do not assert that finite-sample realized ratios equal those identities, or that their expectations do; ratios can be undefined. No failed world is retried to obtain a desired realized contrast.
mathematical_assessment.conditional_covariance: For fixed thresholds pA,pB, common share lambda gives same-time cross-instrument covariance lambda^2*(min(pA,pB)-pA*pB). Same-instrument positive lag k has factor rho^k*(lambda^2+(1-lambda)^2). Raw empirical products also contain mask and conditional-mean structure; negative raw products alone do not prove impossible membership in this latent model.
mathematical_assessment.calendar: Artificial terminal-horizon censoring is retained. Source boundary and source missing outcomes cannot masquerade as maturity on the synthetic calendar. terminal_censored_cases counts true-scope terminal relabels, including already missing outcomes; it is not the number of otherwise eligible cells lost.
mathematical_assessment.scope: Parameters are declared stress assumptions, not fitted or certified. Reports use synthetic estimator-level programs, explicitly record raw_AST_executed=false and cannot claim original H_exec replay.

fixed_hand_expectations.covariance_oracle: An independent enumeration of 500 common/private lattice and share-choice atoms gives means 3/5, 2/5 and same-time cross covariance 1/25 at lambda=1/2. The separate mathematical lag-one mixed-threshold expression is 2/75 at rho=1/3; this is not empirical calibration.
